crossRefs.note: “Oh that you would hide me in Sheol, that you would keep me secret until your wrath is past, that you would appoint me…
One dies in his full strength, being wholly at ease and quiet.
that the evil man is reserved to the day of calamity, That they are led out to the day of wrath?
For I know that you will bring me to death, To the house appointed for all living.
The scepter will not depart from Judah, nor the ruler’s staff from between his feet, until he comes to whom it belongs.…
They will spread them before the sun, the moon, and all the army of the sky, which they have loved, which they have…
His winnowing fork is in his hand, and he will thoroughly cleanse his threshing floor. He will gather his wheat into…
“Jerusalem, Jerusalem, who kills the prophets, and stones those who are sent to her! How often I would have gathered…
yet he will perish forever like his own dung. Those who have seen him will say, ‘Where is he?’
Before your pots can feel the heat of the thorns, he will sweep away the green and the burning alike.
How they are suddenly destroyed! They are completely swept away with terrors.
As a dream when one wakes up, so, Lord, when you awake, you will despise their fantasies.
Those who hate you will be clothed with shame. The tent of the wicked will be no more.”
But man dies, and is laid low. Yes, man gives up the spirit, and where is he?
so man lies down and doesn’t rise. Until the heavens are no more, they will not awake, nor be roused out of their sleep.
They are exalted; yet a little while, and they are gone. Yes, they are brought low, they are taken out of the way as…

translations.web: He lies down rich, but he will not do so again. He opens his eyes, and he is not.
translations.bsb: He lies down wealthy, but will do so no more; when he opens his eyes, all is gone.
translations.kjv: The rich man shall lie down, but he shall not be gathered: he openeth his eyes,
translations.asv: He lieth down rich, but he shall not be gathered to his fathers; He openeth his eyes, and he is not.
